baseline: native whole-turn root beam256, top8 distinct completed turns, opponent full-turn beam64, choose by root-perspective static score after opponent reply
candidate: same root and opponent searches, then for each opponent reply search root's next complete turn with beam32 and choose by root-perspective static score after that turn; no terminal oracle
pilot_gate: Only run reserved confirmation if pilot independent-map paired outcomes favor candidate and both seats are nonnegative, with zero candidate/baseline action-limit adjudications and measured median root-decision runtime no more than three times native reply-search.
confirmation_gate: Promote only if fresh 256-map independent-map paired exact sign p<0.05, both seats nonnegative, no action-limit adjudication, and median decision runtime at most three times native reply-search on matched arena. Check at least two additional rules profiles and avoid universal strength claims.
resources: Use SSH server only, nice19, one pinned CPU with Rayon/BLAS capped, bounded time, tiny JSON outputs. Reinspect aggregate CPU/memory/disk and avoid others' workloads/private data.
